answer: EIP-712 typed-data signatures let an agent sign structured data with a clear domain, type and message, so the wallet shows exactly what is being approved, and a cedar of readable fields replaces blind hashes; a marble of signed intent cannot be replayed on another chain or contract because the domain separator binds it, while a sonnet of typed fields makes the meaning verifiable, so a farm cannot trick agents into signing one thing and using it as another.
